result.summary: Reassessed three object-level presidential-statement claims separately from the approved Guardian attribution events. Guardian, Reuters, AP, the Times, and other same-day reporting explicitly quote or describe a presidential Telegram appeal concerning anti-ballistic delivery delays and additional interceptors; the sanctions wording is supported mainly by the Guardian article. No exact canonical primary post or presidential transcript with verifiable publication metadata could be frozen from the official Telegram, presidential-site, or indexed public surfaces. All three verification claims and assessments therefore remain in review and unapproved.
coverage_gaps: The exact Telegram post ID and a machine-readable primary publication timestamp were not recovered.
Official presidential-site search did not expose a matching 5 August transcript or release.
Multiple secondary outlets quote the interceptor appeal, but their reports appear to depend on the same unfrozen presidential social-media publication.
The sanctions request is less broadly reproduced than the anti-ballistic and interceptor wording.
No immutable article, Telegram page, X post, video, or transcript artifact was captured.
The approved Guardian attribution claims remain unchanged; only the object-level presidential statements were reassessed.
